units.source_text: 皇上常谓藤壶女御名重天下，把她看作盖世无双的美人。

en.t: The emperor often said that Lady Fujitsubo's fame was known throughout the realm, and he regarded her as a peerless beauty.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子的相貌，比她更加光彩焕发，艳丽动人，因此世人称他为“光华公子”（光君）。

en.t: But Prince Genji's appearance shone with even greater brilliance and captivating beauty, so people called him the Shining Prince, Hikaru Genji.

units.source_text: 藤壶女御和源氏公子并受皇上宠爱，因此世人称她为“昭阳妃子”。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo and Prince Genji were both beloved by the emperor, and so people called her the Lady of Shoyang.
